subject: Approval: success story & metrics for renewal decision
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick sync — ask for Lendora success story (renewal/expansion)

Team — quick note before I reach out to Lendora. Renewal conversation hits procurement next week (DL-2025-1147). Their expansion ask is tied to measurable infra savings + improved UX latency. Sales wants a clean success story + an exec quote showing outcomes to accelerate legal/procurement.

Proposed approach:
- Send a short one-pager + 2-question ask for top-line outcomes (latency, cost, conversion uplift).
- Request logo+quote approval from CPO (Luis Herrera) and permission to publish a 1-paragraph case study.
- Offer a short 15-min recorded testimonial instead of a written quote if easier.

Attached is a draft one-pager I’ll send (draft-cs-onepager-v1.pdf). I’ll CC Marissa for CS review and Rishi for legal/contract notes. Please flag anything sensitive — especially around numbers and timelines.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0192

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@lendora.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Lendora success story — quick approval for outcomes and quote?

Hi Alicia,

Hope you’re well. As we prepare Lendora’s renewal package, one thing that would materially help the internal buy (and speed procurement) is a short success story that highlights the outcomes you’ve seen since onboarding Redwood.

Two asks — both optional but very impactful:
1) Can you confirm the top-line outcomes we can share publicly (short bullets):
   - Median inference latency improvement (percent or ms)
   - Estimated infra cost savings (percent)
   - Any product/business impact (e.g., conversion uplift, throughput increase)
2) Would Luis (CPO) be open to a one-line quote we can use in a 1-pager? If a short recorded 1–2 minute statement is easier, we’re happy to schedule.

Attached is a one-pager draft for your review (draft-cs-onepager-v1.pdf). We’ve kept specific numbers off the page until you confirm — I’ve left placeholders. If you prefer, I can send a redline-friendly Google Doc instead.

Timing: procurement is reviewing next Tuesday (2/24), so if we can get sign-off by Wed 2/25 that would be ideal.

Thank you — really appreciate your help here.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft-cs-onepager-v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@lendora.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lendora success story — quick approval for outcomes and quote?

Connor — thanks for the clear note. We’re happy to help — the success story would actually help us internally when we ask procurement to approve budget for the expanded capacity.

Confirmed outcomes you can publish (please use the exact phrasing below):
- Median inference latency reduced by ~45% (from ~220ms to ~120ms) since switching to Redwood inference runtime.
- Average model serving cost decreased by ~32% per 1k tokens (customer-reported).
- Overall throughput for peak inference jobs increased ~2.5x enabling the mobile checkout flow to scale during promos.
- Product impact: A/B test on the mobile checkout funnel showed a +4.2 percentage-point lift in checkout completion when using the new model serving configuration.

For the quote, Luis is okay with a short line but asked for suggested language. He’s copied here: Luis Herrera <luis.herrera@lendora.com>. Procurement contact is procurement@lendora.com for contract logistics.

I attached a quick screenshot of the analytics dashboard for your numbers (redwood_metrics_screenshot.png). We’d prefer the final case study to avoid specific monthly spend numbers but the percentages above are fine to publish.

Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product Ops, Lendora
Attachment: redwood_metrics_screenshot.png (PNG)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Lendora success story — confirmed metrics and next steps

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Alicia’s confirmation. Key notes:
- They approved the four outcome bullets (45% latency, 32% cost, 2.5x throughput, +4.2pp conversion).
- Luis (CPO) is willing to provide a short quote but wants suggested wording.
- Procurement contact included — procurement@lendora.com.

Suggested quote for Luis to approve (one sentence):
"Partnering with Redwood Inference reduced our serving latency and infrastructure cost while enabling higher throughput — a key enabler for our improved mobile checkout experience."

Can we: 1) run this by legal/marketing for any required edits? 2) finalize the 1-pager with the confirmed metrics (I’ll drop the screenshot in) and send to Alicia + Luis for sign-off? I’ll offer the 15-minute recorded quote option as well.

Connor

Cc: Luis Herrera <luis.herrera@lendora.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lendora success story — confirmed metrics and next steps

Connor — looping back with approval. Luis reviewed and provided this final quote (approved for use):

"Redwood’s inference platform gave us predictable performance and measurable cost savings, allowing our product teams to deliver a faster, more reliable checkout experience for customers."

Luis also confirmed: you may use Lendora’s name and logo in the case study; procurement will sign a simple logo consent form (attached). For the record, they prefer we don’t publish specific dollar amounts (percentages are fine).

Next step: would you send the final one-pager with the approved quote and logo consent attached, and we’ll get legal to sign off ASAP. If you’d like Luis on a quick 10–15 min recording (phone or Zoom) to capture tone, he’s available next Tue 3/2 morning PST.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product Ops, Lendora
Attachment: logo-consent.pdf (PDF, signed)
